title: The Spicy soup of the region
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：spicy　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spicy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the coach wrote of ① a spicy soup of the region in the record, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② spicier than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the coach, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the spicy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the spiciest soup of the region anybody in the field had ever seen, or so the record for April 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too spicy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the player who had come to help; the spicy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a spicy story of the traveller, and said that no player in his right mind would call it ⑥ as spicy as the story of the traveller they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was spicy or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something spicy, and nothing besides. The player from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite spicy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the spicy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, without complaint, she wrote of another spicy soup of the region in the same record, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ spicier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The spiciest story of the traveller in the whole field, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the spicy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 辛辣（前置定语 a spicy soup of the region：1950 年教练在赛事记录里记下的那件辛辣的汤）
B. adj. 辛辣／刺激（比较级 spicier than：文中两处，一处比当地辛辣的汤，一处比预想）
C. adj. 辛辣／刺激（最高级 the spiciest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 辛辣（表语 too spicy to do：母亲觉得它太辛辣，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 刺激（前置定语 a spicy story of the traveller：叔叔把整件事称作一桩刺激的见闻）
F. adj. 刺激（同级比较 as spicy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩旅行者刺激的见闻相比）
G. adj. 刺激（后置定语 something spicy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 刺激（受程度副词修饰 quite spicy：那位队员的评价）

items.q: a spicy soup of the region
the spiciest soup of the region anybody
a spicy story of the traveller
The spiciest story of the traveller in

answers.why: spicy 意为“辛辣”，1950 年教练在赛事记录里记下的是“一件辛辣的汤”，此处作前置定语 a spicy soup of the region。
spicy 意为“辛辣”，此处用比较级 spicier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
spicy 意为“辛辣”，赛事记录上 四月 那行字说它是球场里最辛辣的一件，故用最高级 the spiciest soup of the region。
spicy 意为“辛辣”，母亲认为这件东西“太辛辣了，谁也用不上”，too spicy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
spicy 意为“刺激”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩刺激的见闻”，此处作前置定语 a spicy story of the traveller。
spicy 意为“刺激”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩旅行者刺激的见闻一样刺激”，同级比较用 as spicy as。
spicy 意为“刺激”，赛事记录上那半行字要的是“刺激的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something spicy。
spicy 意为“刺激”，邻球场来的那位队员认为这套计划“相当刺激”，quite 修饰原级 spicy。
spicy 意为“刺激”，1960 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要刺激”，故用比较级 spicier than。
spicy 意为“刺激”，母亲 1962 年说的是“整个球场里最刺激的那一桩”，故用最高级 the spiciest story of the traveller。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，教练在赛事记录里记下了一件辛辣的汤。（a spicy soup of the region）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更辛辣。（spicier than …）
母亲觉得它太辛辣，谁也用不上。（too spicy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩刺激的见闻。（a spicy story of the traveller）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩旅行者刺激的见闻一样刺激。（as spicy as …）
到了 1957 年，赛事记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件刺激的东西。（something spicy）
answers: In 1950 the coach wrote of a spicy soup of the region in the record.
Everybody said it was spicier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too spicy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a spicy story of the traveller.
He said nobody would call it as spicy as the story of the traveller they had once had.
By 1957 the record asked for nothing but something spicy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 spicy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the coach wrote of a spicy soup of the region in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the spiciest soup of the region in the field, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too spicy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a spicy story of the traveller, and nobody argued with him.
The player from the next field called the plan quite spicy, and everybody laughed.
The spicy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
